mentions.name: Past Visiting Hours
mentions.description: A multiplayer horror game built with Godot and Blender, using Qwen3 TTS and AI tools (Deepseek with Pi) to rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay. It is available to wishlist on Steam ahead of a planned release priced around $5.
mentions.source_excerpt: As a passion project. I have been working on building a multiplayer horror game using AI.
